text:
incident-bot: page fired -> capacity_exhaustion: inference-queue backlog > 90% for cell 'eu-west-1-inference-03' (alert: queue_depth_high)
pagerduty: Triggered: Capacity Exhaustion / Queue Backlog (INC-12581) — routed to eng-oncall rota
mira (oncall): acked on pagerduty :thumbsup: I'm on it, pulling runbook: https://runbook.internal/inference/queue-backlog
mira (oncall): quick status: queue depth 92%, median latency 2.3s -> jumped to 6-12s for some requests, 502 rate ~3%
oliver (infra): I'm seeing lots of Pending Pods in k8s, pod create timeouts. Kubectl describe shows cloud provider failing to attach volumes in some nodes
jason (eng-sre): autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts but KubeAPI rate-limited: 429 from cloud control plane, backoff kicking in. Also seeing node provisioning stuck: "InsufficientResource: quota exceeded"
mira (oncall): trying manual scale to bypass autoscaler: `kubectl scale --replicas=10 deployment/inference-hotpath -n infra` -> ERROR: pods stuck Pending, reason=FailedCreate (InsufficientResource)
oliver (infra): confirmed, constraint is cloud quota for GPU type g4dn. Requesting quota increase with tickets.devops #4572, but that will take time. For now we can try decreasing replicas but move more traffic to best-effort pool
jason (eng-sre): suggestion: shift routing weights at the controller to route degraded traffic to hosted-fallback model (lower-cost, lower-throughput) and enable prefix-KV cache to reduce new-token work. I can flip routing policy if mira approves
mira (oncall): do it. Also enable temporary rate-limit for heavy customers: customersupport can shepherd top 3 affected accounts
customersupport: posted to affected customers and paused non-critical ingest for two accounts per ops playbook
pagerduty: INC-12581 acknowledged by mira (oncall) at 2025-08-17T09:45:22Z
jason (eng-sre): executing quick routing change: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane.internal/routing/switch -d '{"from":"hotpath","to":"fallback","pct":40}'` -> response 200, weights shifting
mira (oncall): seeing queue drop to 65% within 120s, 500s down to 1.1%, latency improving to ~3s median
oliver (infra): temporary plan: 1) open cloud quota escalation, 2) if quota delayed, provision heterogeneous nodes (smaller gpus + quantized model variant) for hotpool, 3) follow up auto-scaler tuning: increase maxSurge and reduce cooldown
jason (eng-sre): noted post-incident action items: autoscaler should detect cloud API 429s and switch to alternate scaling strategy; add alert for scale-failures and quota-exceeded error patterns
mira (oncall): handing off to jason for follow-up and P0 writeup. I'll stay for 10 more minutes to observe. Thanks everyone :heart:
incident-bot: pagerduty update -> INC-12581 status: acknowledged, assigned=jason (eng-sre)
mira (oncall): closing on-call window, leaving notes in incident channel and will attach logs + timeline. Last observed queue depth 48% at handoff time.
